question: Can selective context-gated sparse residual-energy repair preserve previously learned intervention predictions and beat strong fully trained conventional corrective learners on new and cold causal environments?
hypothesis: Candidate should maintain old MSE within 1% of its frozen stage-one checkpoint, exceed best conventional cold MSE by >=10%, exceed conventional exactly matched OMP2 residual repair by >=5%, and identify >=80% of the two stage-specific causal support identities.

data.provenance: Unchanged ENERGY-43 source-generated independent synthetic 12-bit randomized actions with 364 author-specified unary/pair/triple parity and AND features. No real data or native Yggdrasil checkpoint. New seeds, no reuse of ENERGY-43 primary seeds.
data.hidden_rule: Three invariant signed causal supports, one old-only support and one new-only support, all on first ten unknown causal bits. Two nuisance cue bits change correlations across old/new/cold settings. Independent Gaussian consequence noise sigma .3. Generator hidden factor ids and weights evaluator-only.
data.leakage_guard: Only observed randomized intervention actions, stage, and train consequences provided to methods. Planted support and weights and all held consequences used only after fitting for scoring. Old/new/cold streams hash-separated.

algorithm.candidate: Train frozen OMP4 factor supports on 96 old outcomes. On new context compute residual y_new - frozen_old_model(x_new). Rank all 364 features by normalized new-witness residual correlation, enumerate all unordered pairs in top16 (120) and fit ridge=.02 weights, choose minimum observed new residual MSE + .0001*L2; apply exactly two corrections ONLY in new/cold context. Old model never updated. Externally named classical sparse residual-energy minimization, no physical energy claim.

strong_controls.omp_delta2: Identical frozen OMP4, use same 96 new residual observations and conventional sklearn OMP2 over all 364 features to fit two correction factors; exact capacity and inputs matched.
strong_controls.omp_structural_memory: Conventional cumulative 192-observation OMP structural memory, three old locked factors and up to 7 active gated supports (ENERGY-43 strongest).
strong_controls.full_omp7: Standard OMP 7 over 728 gated grammar features fit to same 192 outcomes.
strong_controls.stagewise_retrain: Separate 4-support OMP on 96 new observed consequences, frozen old OMP for old context.
strong_controls.ridge: Ridge alpha40 fit full cumulative gated grammar.
strong_controls.elasticnet: ElasticNet alpha .025 l1_ratio .85 max_iter5000 tol1e-5 fit full gated grammar.
strong_controls.forest: Random forest 60 trees max_depth9 min_leaf3 n_jobs1, raw action+stage fit same 192 outcomes
strong_controls.no_repair: Old model with no new adaptation. Causal adaptation ablation.
strong_controls.shuffled_delta: Same exact two-factor candidate with deterministically shuffled new residual targets. Negative learning control.

algorithm.model_capacity: Candidate freezes 4 stage-one supports plus 2 delta supports, OMP delta comparator same 4+2. Larger-capacity control models retained and included in strongest comparator; cannot selectively ignore them.
algorithm.compute: One 36-world primary score with fresh fixed seeds, one unchanged-source semantic replay, independently authored 10-arm full refit audit. Fixed two-factor pair search among top16. No primary tuning.
algorithm.timing: Linux CPU Python3.13.5 NumPy2.3.5 scikit-learn1.8.0, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1. Sum per-arm fit+prediction Python wall seconds, excluding source generation, Python start, CI and audit; physical energy not measured.

frozen_gates.cold_gain_vs_best_control_10pct: Candidate mean cold MSE <= .90 × lowest mean cold MSE among omp_delta2,omp_structural_memory,full_omp7,stagewise_retrain,ridge,elasticnet,forest.
frozen_gates.old_retention_max_1pct: Candidate old held after new training MSE <= 1.01 × identical frozen old checkpoint MSE.
frozen_gates.old_vs_best_control_5pct: Candidate old MSE <= 1.05 × minimum old MSE among seven conventional fitted controls.
frozen_gates.cold_gain_vs_omp_delta2_5pct: Candidate cold MSE <= .95 × OMP2 corrective delta cold MSE.
frozen_gates.cold_gain_vs_shuffled_20pct: Candidate cold MSE <= .80 × shuffled new-outcome corrective candidate MSE.
frozen_gates.new_mechanism_delta_recall_80pct: Across 36 cases candidate selected context-delta supports include at least 80% of two true stage-specific factor IDs (old-only and new-only).
frozen_gates.seed_stability_2of3: Candidate seed-mean cold MSE lower than strongest conventional comparator separately in >=2 of 3 fixed primary seeds.
frozen_gates.fit_predict_cpu_max_3x_omp_structural: Candidate sum fit+predict local seconds <=3 × conventional OMP structural-memory sum, without claiming full-system cost.

decision_rules.development_go: All 8 prospectively frozen gates true and independent all-world refit audit PASS. Does not qualify native training, scientific acceptance or deployment.
decision_rules.development_no_go: Any frozen gate fails with valid provenance, data and independent audit. Preserve negative, stop tuning consumed seeds.
decision_rules.invalid: Any source/hash/prereg ordering mismatch, leakage, missing matched control, changed sample budget or seed, invalid exact error computation, independent refit audit failure or shuffled negative not applied.
decision_rules.mixed: Report all failures and controls, per-seed and per-family outcomes without tuning or changing the primary definition.
